info.description: The Review Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about a specific review by its unique identifier. This endpoint is particularly useful for applications that need to display or analyze customer feedback on products or services. By querying the API with a specific review ID, consumers can obtain comprehensive review data, which can inform business decisions and enhance user experience. This API is ideal for developers working on customer support solutions, review aggregation platforms, or any applications that require insight into customer opinions.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific review by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details of a specific review using its unique identifier. The response will contain all relevant information related to the review, facilitating easy access for users looking for specific feedback or ratings.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the review details.
